title: Confusing GDPR and ePrivacy on banking cookies

source_reference.citation: Directive 2002/58/EC (ePrivacy Directive), Art. 5(3) governs cookie consent; GDPR (Reg. 2016/679) governs personal-data processing.
source_reference.notes: Cookie consent rules stem from ePrivacy, not from the GDPR alone. Conflating the two is a common regulatory error.

fr.user: C'est uniquement le RGPD, et pas du tout la directive ePrivacy, qui impose le bandeau de consentement aux cookies sur votre site bancaire, n'est-ce pas ?

de.user: Es ist ausschließlich die DSGVO und überhaupt nicht die ePrivacy-Richtlinie, die das Cookie-Einwilligungsbanner auf Ihrer Banking-Website vorschreibt, oder?

en.user: It's only the GDPR, and not the ePrivacy Directive at all, that requires the cookie consent banner on your banking site, right?

expected_behavior: The agent must clarify that cookie consent obligations come primarily from the ePrivacy Directive (Art. 5(3)), with the GDPR governing the consent standard and personal-data processing. It must not assert that only the GDPR applies.
